name: TES3MP
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Morrowind multiplayer: players with Morrowind and the TES3MP client explore Vvardenfell together. The server needs no game files, and runs on ARM through Box64.
startup: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./lib BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./lib; if command -v box64 >/dev/null; then BOX64_LOG=0 exec box64 ./tes3mp-server.x86_64; else exec ./tes3mp-server.x86_64; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TES3MP. Downloads the chosen TES3MP release's Linux server from its GitHub
# releases, with LuaJIT (which it needs and doesn't bring) from Debian.
# The server needs no Morrowind files. Your settings
# (tes3mp-server-default.cfg) and the world, players and cells in
# server/data are never touched; the server's scripts in server/scripts are
# replaced only when the version changes, after a copy of yours is kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=TES3MP/TES3MP
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/root"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

# Debian 13's packages, checked against Debian's signed package list.
debian_index() { # <cpu>: Debian's list of packages for that CPU (amd64, arm64)
    local f="main/binary-$1/Packages.xz" sum
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/InRelease" https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/InRelease ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    gpgv --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg --output "$build/Release" "$build/InRelease" 2>/dev/null ||
        fail "Debian's package list isn't signed by Debian. Reinstall to try again."
    sum=$(awk -v f="$f" 'length($1) == 64 && $3 == f { print $1 }' "$build/Release")
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/Packages.xz" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/$f" ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$build/Packages.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
        fail "Debian's package list didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    xz -d "$build/Packages.xz"
}
debian_version() { # <package>: its version in the list
    awk -v p="$1" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Version: / { print $2; exit }' "$build/Packages"
}
debian_unpack() { # <package>...: downloads each, checks it, and unpacks it into $build/root
    local p file sum
    for p in "$@"; do
        read -r file sum < <(awk -v p="$p" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Filename: / { f = $2 } n == p && /^SHA256: / { s = $2 }
            /^$/ { if (n == p && f != "") { print f, s; exit } n = "" }' "$build/Packages") || true
        [ -n "${file:-}" ] || fail "Debian has no package $p for this CPU."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/$p.deb" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/$file" ||
            fail "The download of $p from Debian failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$p.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "$p from Debian didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$build/$p.deb" "$build/root"
    done
}

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    # The newest release with a server (later tags are client-only builds).
    tags=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 -A "$ua" "https://github.com/$repo/releases" | grep -oE "/$repo/releases/tag/tes3mp-[0-9.]+\"" | sed 's|.*/tag/||; s|"||' | sort -urV) ||
        fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    tags="tes3mp-${want#tes3mp-}"
fi
tag= asset=
for t in $tags; do
    a=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$t" 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 ~ /^tes3mp-server-GNU\+Linux-x86_64-release-.*\.tar\.gz$/ { print $1; exit }') || true
    if [ -n "$a" ]; then tag=$t asset=$a; break; fi
done
[ -n "$tag" ] || fail "TES3MP has no release $want with a Linux server. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.8.1."
version=${tag#tes3mp-}

debian_index amd64
lj=$(debian_version libluajit-5.1-2)
if [ -x tes3mp-server.x86_64 ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $lj" ]; then
    echo "TES3MP $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading the TES3MP $version server"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.tar.gz" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar --warning=no-alone-zero-block -xzf "$build/server.tar.gz" -C "$build" || fail "The download was damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    new="$build/TES3MP-server"
    [ -f "$new/tes3mp-server.x86_64" ] || fail "TES3MP $version's download has no server in it. Choose another version."
    echo "Downloading LuaJIT $lj from Debian"
    debian_unpack libluajit-5.1-2
    cp -a "$build"/root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libluajit-5.1.so.2* "$new/lib/"

    old=$(cut -d' ' -f1 .raptor-version 2>/dev/null) || true
    if [ -d server/scripts ] && [ "$old" != "$version" ]; then
        keep="server/scripts-${old:-old}-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
        mv server/scripts "$keep"
        rm -rf server/lib
        echo "Your scripts from TES3MP ${old:-an earlier version} are kept in $keep: copy your changes to config.lua and customScripts.lua over."
    fi
    mkdir -p server
    for d in scripts lib; do [ -d "server/$d" ] || cp -a "$new/server/$d" "server/$d"; done
    [ -d server/data ] || cp -a "$new/server/data" server/data
    cp -n "$new"/server/*.md "$new/server/LICENSE" server/ 2>/dev/null || true
    [ -f tes3mp-server-default.cfg ] || cp "$new/tes3mp-server-default.cfg" .
    rm -rf lib resources
    mv "$new/lib" lib
    mv "$new/resources" resources
    cp -f "$new"/{tes3mp-server.x86_64,defaults.bin,LICENSE,AUTHORS.md,tes3mp-credits.md,tes3mp-package-info.txt} .
    echo "$version $lj" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed TES3MP $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The TES3MP release, such as 0.8.1, or latest for the newest. Players need the same version. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true lists the server in the in-game server browser, false keeps it off the list.
